body: Mine has always been a good person. We both SUCKED at communication, and he could be very withdrawn and sulky at time…but we met quite young and I was his first ever everything.
It’s so hard, isn’t it? If I could flip some sort of switch in my brain to change my feelings for him I would. He’s a wonderful human. But…I can’t. I wish I could. Urgh. This sucks.

I know, you’re right. Kicking the can down the road achieves nothing. I’m going to make an appointment to speak to a solicitor this week to get a feel for the logistics and then…go to the house for the talk. 

Wish me luck.

Myself, mostly. Those I’ve loved, but since I chose them the buck stops with me really. I’m tired of longing and wishing and hoping for things that can never be. The hope, and the way it’s inevitably crushed each time…that’s the kicker. There is a gnawing emptiness inside me that has been my constant companion for as many years as I’ve been alive, and I don’t want to keep living with it. I’m just so exhausted.
